  return {
    type: 'function',
    function: {
      name,
      description,
      parameters: { type: 'object', properties, required: required || [] },
    },
  };
}

/** Исполнение инструментов ТЗ. Файлы — только через переданный fs (корень workspace). */

const PLATFORM_TOOLS = new Set([
  'run_query',
  'inspect_metadata',
  'read_object',
  'make_navlink',
  'sketch_query',
  'delegate_task',
  'report_describe',
  'report_run',
  'report_compose',
  'open_draft',
]);

const ALIASES = {
  read_file: 'fs_read',
  write_file: 'fs_write',
};

const WEEKDAYS = ['воскресенье', 'понедельник', 'вторник', 'среда', 'четверг', 'пятница', 'суббота'];
const MAX_CHARS = 200000;
const TEXT_EXT = /\.(txt|md|json|xml|csv|bsl|js|html|css|log)$/i;

function normalizeRel(rel) {
  const p = String(rel || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\/+/, '');
  if (!p || p.split('/').includes('..')) throw new Error('Недопустимый путь');
  return p;
}

function globToRegExp(pattern) {
  let re = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < pattern.length; i += 1) {
    const c = pattern[i];
    if (c === '*') {
      if (pattern[i + 1] === '*') {
        re += '.*';
        i += 1;
        if (pattern[i + 1] === '/') i += 1;
      } else {
        re += '[^/]*';
      }
    } else if ('.+^${}()|[]\\'.includes(c)) {
      re += `\\${c}`;
    } else {
      re += c;
    }
  }
  return new RegExp(`^${re}$`, 'i');
}

function sliceLines(content, offset, limit) {
  const lines = String(content).split('\n');
  const start = Math.max(1, Number(offset) || 1);
  const take = limit == null ? lines.length : Math.max(0, Number(limit));
  const slice = lines.slice(start - 1, start - 1 + take);
  return { content: slice.join('\n'), start, lines: slice.length, total: lines.length };
}

function safeCalc(expression) {
  const raw = String(expression || '').trim();
  const compact = raw.replace(/\s+/g, '');
  if (!compact || !/^[\d.eE+\-*/()%]+$/.test(compact)) {
    throw new Error('Допустимы только числа и + - * / % скобки');
  }
  const value = Function(`"use strict"; return (${compact})`)();
  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) throw new Error('Результат не число');
  return { expression: raw, value };
}

function chartSpec(args) {
  const raw = String(args.type || 'bar').trim().toLowerCase();
  let type = 'bar';
  if (raw.includes('hbar') || raw.includes('horizontal') || raw.includes('гориз')) type = 'hbar';
  else if (raw.includes('line') || raw.includes('лин')) type = 'line';
  const labels = Array.isArray(args.labels) ? args.labels.map(String) : [];
  const series = Array.isArray(args.data) ? args.data : args.values;
  const data = Array.isArray(series) ? series.map(Number) : [];
  if (!labels.length || labels.length !== data.length || data.some((n) => !Number.isFinite(n))) {
    throw new Error('labels и data — массивы одной длины из чисел');
  }
  return {
    type,
    title: String(args.title || ''),
    labels,
    datasets: [{ label: String(args.title || 'Ряд'), data }],
  };
}

function excerpt(text, query) {
  const src = String(text || '');
  const at = src.toLowerCase().indexOf(String(query).toLowerCase());
  if (at < 0) return '';
  const from = Math.max(0, at - 40);
  return src.slice(from, at + query.length + 80).replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

/**
 * @param {string} name
 * @param {object} args
 * @param {{read: Function, write: Function, list: Function, searchChats: Function, readSkills: Function}} fs
 */
async function executeHarnessTool(name, args, fs) {
  args = args || {};
  const tool = ALIASES[name] || name;
  if (tool === 'read_agent_md') {
    const id = String(args.agent_id || 'default').trim();
    if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/.test(id)) throw new Error('Недопустимый agent_id');
    const content = await fs.read(`agents/${id}.md`);
    return { path: `agents/${id}.md`, agent_id: id, content };
  }
  if (PLATFORM_TOOLS.has(tool)) {
    const error = new Error('Инструмент выполняется только в сеансе 1С');
    error.hints = tool === 'run_query'
      ? ['Запрос с РАЗРЕШЕННЫЕ выполняется на платформе', 'Ссылки в params: { type, uuid }']
      : undefined;
    throw error;
  }
  if (tool === 'session_now') {
    const now = new Date();
    return {
      iso: now.toISOString(),
      weekday: WEEKDAYS[now.getDay()],
      local: now.toLocaleString('ru-RU'),
    };
  }
  if (tool === 'calc') return safeCalc(args.expression);
  if (tool === 'draw_chart') {
    const chart = chartSpec(args);
    return { chart, hint: 'Превью графика добавляет интерфейс чата.' };
  }
  if (tool === 'find_in_chat') {
    const query = String(args.query || '').trim();
    if (!query) throw new Error('Пустой query');
    const hits = await fs.searchChats(query);
    return { query, hits: hits.slice(0, 20) };
  }
  if (tool === 'find_skill') {
    const query = String(args.query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) throw new Error('Пустой query');
    const docs = await fs.readSkills();
    const hits = docs
      .filter((d) => `${d.path}\n${d.content}`.toLowerCase().includes(query))
      .map((d) => ({ path: d.path, excerpt: excerpt(d.content, query) || d.path }));
    return { query: args.query, hits: hits.slice(0, 20) };
  }
  if (tool === 'fs_list') {
    const dir = args.path ? normalizeRel(args.path).replace(/\/$/, '') : '';
    const paths = await fs.list();
    const entries = new Map();
    for (const rel of paths) {
      if (dir && rel !== dir && !rel.startsWith(`${dir}/`)) continue;
      const rest = dir ? rel.slice(dir.length + 1) : rel;
      if (!rest) continue;
      const name = rest.split('/')[0];
      if (name === '.keep') continue;
      const child = dir ? `${dir}/${name}` : name;
      const isDir = rest.includes('/') || paths.some((p) => p.startsWith(`${child}/`));
      entries.set(name, { name, type: isDir ? 'dir' : 'file', path: child });
    }
    return { path: dir || '.', entries: [...entries.values()].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)) };
  }
  if (tool === 'fs_read') {
    const path = normalizeRel(args.path);
    let content = await fs.read(path);
    if (content.length > MAX_CHARS) content = content.slice(0, MAX_CHARS);
    if (args.offset || args.limit) {
      const sliced = sliceLines(content, args.offset, args.limit);
      return { path, ...sliced };
    }
    return { path, content };
  }
  if (tool === 'fs_write') {
    const path = normalizeRel(args.path);
    const content = args.content ?? '';
    await fs.write(path, content);
    return { path, bytes: String(content).length, ok: true };
  }
  if (tool === 'fs_mkdir') {
    const path = normalizeRel(args.path).replace(/\/$/, '');
    await fs.write(`${path}/.keep`, '');
    return { path, ok: true };
  }
  if (tool === 'fs_edit') {
    const path = normalizeRel(args.path);
    const oldText = String(args.old_text ?? '');
    const fresh = String(args.new_text ?? '');
    if (!oldText) throw new Error('Пустой old_text');
    const content = await fs.read(path);
    const count = content.split(oldText).length - 1;
    if (count === 0) throw new Error('Фрагмент не найден');
    if (count > 1) throw new Error('Фрагмент встречается больше одного раза');
    const next = content.replace(oldText, fresh);
    await fs.write(path, next);
    return { path, ok: true };
  }
  if (tool === 'fs_glob') {
    const pattern = String(args.pattern || '').trim();
    if (!pattern) throw new Error('Пустой pattern');
    const re = globToRegExp(pattern.replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    const paths = (await fs.list()).filter((p) => re.test(p) || re.test(p.split('/').pop()));
    return { pattern, paths: paths.slice(0, 200) };
  }
  if (tool === 'fs_search') {
    const query = String(args.query || '');
    if (!query) throw new Error('Пустой query');
    const root = args.path ? normalizeRel(args.path) : '';
    const paths = await fs.list();
    const hits = [];
    for (const path of paths) {
      if (root && path !== root && !path.startsWith(`${root}/`)) continue;
      if (!TEXT_EXT.test(path)) continue;
      let content = '';
      try {
        content = await fs.read(path);
      } catch {
        continue;
      }
      if (!content.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())) continue;
      hits.push({ path, excerpt: excerpt(content, query) });
      if (hits.length >= 30) break;
    }
    return { query, hits };
  }
  throw new Error(`Неизвестный инструмент: ${name}`);
}

function toolErrorPayload(error) {
  return {
    message: error?.message || String(error),
    hints: error?.hints,
  };
}

/** Вызов инструментов только через мост платформы 1С (DOM). */

function isReal1CBridge() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  return params.get('backend') === '1c' || window.__1CHarnessBackend === true;
}

let bridgeWaiters = new Map();

function installDomBridgeListener() {
  document.addEventListener('harness-1c-response', (ev) => {
    const data = ev.detail;
    if (data?.id && bridgeWaiters.has(data.id)) {
      const { resolve } = bridgeWaiters.get(data.id);
      bridgeWaiters.delete(data.id);
      resolve(data);
    }
  });
}

function postDomBridge(payload) {
  const json = JSON.stringify(payload);
  const bridge = document.getElementById('harness-1c-bridge');
  if (bridge) {
    bridge.textContent = json;
    bridge.dataset.seq = String(Date.now());
  }
  try {
    if (window.HarnessNative?.postMessage) window.HarnessNative.postMessage(json);
  } catch (_) { /* not in 1C host */ }
  document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('harness-1c-request', { detail: payload }));
}

function waitDomBridge(id, timeoutMs) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      bridgeWaiters.delete(id);
      reject(new Error('Таймаут моста 1С'));
    }, timeoutMs);
    bridgeWaiters.set(id, {
      resolve: (data) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve(data);
      },
    });
  });
}

/** @returns {Promise<{ok:boolean, result?: object, error?: string}>} */
async function invoke1cTool(tool, args, options = {}) {
  const id = `tool-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  const payload = { type: 'tool.invoke', id, tool, arguments: args || {} };
  const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 30000;

  const dataPromise = waitDomBridge(id, timeoutMs);
  postDomBridge(payload);
  const data = await dataPromise;
  if (data.type === 'tool.result') {
    let error = data.error;
    if (!data.ok && Array.isArray(data.hints) && data.hints.length) {
      error = `${error}\n${data.hints.join('\n')}`;
    }
    return { ok: !!data.ok, result: data.result, error };
  }
  return { ok: false, error: data.error || 'Неверный ответ моста' };
}

/** Для платформы 1С: window.harnessDeliverResponse({ type, id, ok, result }) */
function wireHarnessDeliverResponse() {
  const prev = window.harnessDeliverResponse;
  window.harnessDeliverResponse = function (payload) {
    const data = typeof payload === 'string' ? JSON.parse(payload) : payload;
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('harness-1c-response', { detail: data }));
    if (typeof prev === 'function') prev(payload);
  };
}


const CONFIG_PATH = 'config.json';

const DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
  connection: {
    apiBase: 'https://ollama.com/v1',
    apiStyle: 'openai',
    model: 'gemma4:31b-cloud',
    apiKey: '',
  },
  generation: {
    temperature: 0.4,
  },
};

/** @type {typeof DEFAULT_CONFIG | null} */
let cache = null;

function mergeConfig(raw) {
  const parsed = typeof raw === 'object' && raw ? raw : {};
  return {
    connection: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG.connection, ...(parsed.connection || {}) },
    generation: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG.generation, ...(parsed.generation || {}) },
  };
}

const DEV_PROXY_BASE_RE = /\/dev-llm\/|127\.0\.0\.1:\d+\/dev-llm/i;

function normalizeApiBase(base) {
  const b = String(base || '').trim();
  if (!b || DEV_PROXY_BASE_RE.test(b)) return DEFAULT_CONFIG.connection.apiBase;
  return b;
}

function bootstrapFromDevEnv() {
  let changed = false;
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  const normalized = normalizeApiBase(cache.connection.apiBase);
  if (normalized !== cache.connection.apiBase) {
    cache.connection.apiBase = normalized;
    changed = true;
  }
  const key = window.__HARNESS_LLM_API_KEY;
  if (key && !cache.connection.apiKey) {
    cache.connection.apiKey = key;
    changed = true;
  }
  return changed;
}

async function writeConfigFile() {
  const content = JSON.stringify(cache, null, 2);
  const out = await invoke1cTool('fs_write', { path: CONFIG_PATH, content });
  if (!out.ok) throw new Error(out.error || 'Не удалось записать config.json');
}

async function loadWorkspaceConfig() {
  const out = await invoke1cTool('fs_read', { path: CONFIG_PATH });
  if (out.ok) {
    try {
      cache = mergeConfig(JSON.parse(out.result.content));
    } catch {
      cache = mergeConfig(null);
    }
  } else {
    cache = mergeConfig(null);
  }
  cache.connection.apiBase = normalizeApiBase(cache.connection.apiBase);
  const devBootstrap = bootstrapFromDevEnv();
  if (!out.ok || devBootstrap) {
    try {
      await writeConfigFile();
    } catch {
      /* dev: read-only workspace — ключ всё равно в cache */
    }
  }
  return cache;
}

function getWorkspaceConfig() {
  if (!cache) return mergeConfig(null);
  return cache;
}

function getConnectionSettings() {
  return { ...getWorkspaceConfig().connection };
}

async function updateConnectionSettings(partial) {
  if (!cache) await loadWorkspaceConfig();
  cache.connection = { ...cache.connection, ...partial };
  await writeConfigFile();
  return cache.connection;
}

async function updateGenerationSettings(partial) {
  if (!cache) await loadWorkspaceConfig();
  cache.generation = { ...cache.generation, ...partial };
  await writeConfigFile();
  return cache.generation;
}

/** Запускать только после installStub1CPlatformOnBridge (см. harness-agent-boot.js). */
let configReadyPromise = null;

function ensureWorkspaceConfigLoaded() {
  if (!configReadyPromise) {
    configReadyPromise = loadWorkspaceConfig().catch((err) => {
      configReadyPromise = null;
      throw err;
    });
  }
  return configReadyPromise;
}

/** Прямой XHR к LLM (OpenAI-compatible или Ollama /api/chat), без локального прокси. */


const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 300000;

function getLlmSettings() {
  const c = getConnectionSettings();
  return {
    apiBase: (c.apiBase || 'https://ollama.com/v1').replace(/\/+$/, ''),
    apiStyle: c.apiStyle === 'ollama' ? 'ollama' : 'openai',
    model: c.model || 'gemma4:31b-cloud',
    apiKey: c.apiKey || (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.__HARNESS_LLM_API_KEY) || '',
    timeoutMs: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS,
  };
}

/** @param {'openai'|'ollama'} apiStyle */
function llmChatPath(apiStyle) {
  return apiStyle === 'ollama' ? '/api/chat' : '/v1/chat/completions';
}

function buildLlmUrl(apiBase, path) {
  const base = apiBase.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const p = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`;
  if (base.endsWith('/v1') && p.startsWith('/v1/')) {
    return base.replace(/\/v1$/, '') + p;
  }
  return base + p;
}

/** localhost + ollama.com в config → same-origin relay (CORS); в 1С — прямой URL. */
function resolveLlmPostUrl(apiBase, path) {
  const direct = buildLlmUrl(apiBase, path);
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return direct;
  const host = window.location.hostname;
  const localDev = host === 'localhost' || host === '127.0.0.1';
  const ollamaCloud = /ollama\.com/i.test(apiBase);
  if (localDev && ollamaCloud) {
    const p = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`;
    return `${window.location.origin}/dev-llm/v1${p.replace(/^\/v1/, '')}`;
  }
  return direct;
}

function applyLlmAuthHeaders(xhr, apiKey) {
  if (apiKey) {
    xhr.setRequestHeader('Authorization', `Bearer ${apiKey}`);
  }
}

/**
 * @returns {Promise<object>} parsed JSON body
 */
function postLlmViaXhr(payload, options = {}) {
  const settings = getLlmSettings();
  const path = llmChatPath(settings.apiStyle);
  const url = resolveLlmPostUrl(settings.apiBase, path);
  const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? settings.timeoutMs;
  const signal = options.signal;

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    let aborted = false;

    const cleanup = () => {
      if (signal) signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    };

    const onAbort = () => {
      aborted = true;
      try { xhr.abort(); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
      cleanup();
      reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
    };

    if (signal?.aborted) {
      onAbort();
      return;
    }
    if (signal) signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort);

    xhr.open('POST', url, true);
    xhr.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'application/json');
    xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json; charset=utf-8');
    applyLlmAuthHeaders(xhr, settings.apiKey);
    xhr.timeout = timeoutMs;

    xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
      if (xhr.readyState !== 4 || aborted) return;
      cleanup();
      const text = xhr.responseText || '';
      if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
        try {
          resolve(JSON.parse(text));
        } catch {
          reject(new Error('LLM: неверный JSON в ответе'));
        }
        return;
      }
      if (xhr.status) {
        reject(new Error(`HTTP ${xhr.status}\n${text}`.trim()));
        return;
      }
      reject(new Error('Нет ответа от сервера LLM.'));
    };

    xhr.onerror = function () {
      if (aborted) return;
      cleanup();
      reject(new Error('Ошибка сети: запрос к LLM не выполнен.'));
    };

    xhr.ontimeout = function () {
      if (aborted) return;
      cleanup();
      reject(new Error('Превышен таймаут запроса к LLM.'));
    };

    try {
      xhr.send(JSON.stringify(payload));
    } catch (e) {
      cleanup();
      reject(e instanceof Error ? e : new Error('Ошибка отправки запроса к LLM.'));
    }
  });
}

/** OpenAI chat/completions → assistant message (Ollama /api/chat совместим по message). */
function extractAssistantMessage(data, apiStyle) {
  if (apiStyle === 'ollama') {
    const msg = data.message;
    if (msg) return msg;
  }
  return data.choices?.[0]?.message;
}


const MAX_TOOL_STEPS = 8;

function getAgentConfig() {
  const llm = getLlmSettings();
  return {
    model: llm.model,
    apiBase: llm.apiBase,
    apiStyle: llm.apiStyle,
    maxToolSteps: MAX_TOOL_STEPS,
  };
}

function parseToolCalls(message) {
  if (!message) return [];
  if (Array.isArray(message.tool_calls) && message.tool_calls.length) return message.tool_calls;
  return [];
}

async function chatCompletion(body, signal) {
  const settings = getLlmSettings();
  const payload =
    settings.apiStyle === 'ollama'
      ? { model: body.model, messages: body.messages, stream: false, tools: body.tools }
      : body;
  const data = await postLlmViaXhr(payload, { signal });
  const msg = extractAssistantMessage(data, settings.apiStyle);
  if (!msg) throw new Error('LLM: пустой ответ');
  return { raw: data, message: msg };
}

async function executeToolCall(tc) {
  const fn = tc.function || {};
  let args = {};
  try {
    args = fn.arguments ? JSON.parse(fn.arguments) : {};
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Некорректные arguments JSON' };
  }
  return invoke1cTool(fn.name, args);
}

async function runAgentTurn(opts) {
  const cfg = getAgentConfig();
  const messages = [...opts.messages];
  const signal = opts.signal;
  let steps = 0;
  const failStreak = new Map();
  let delegateEmpty = 0;
  const charts = [];

  while (steps < cfg.maxToolSteps) {
    steps += 1;
    const body = {
      model: cfg.model,
      messages,
      tools: HARNESS_OPENAI_TOOLS,
      stream: false,
      temperature: opts.temperature ?? 0.4,
    };
    const { message: msg } = await chatCompletion(body, signal);

    const toolCalls = parseToolCalls(msg);
    if (toolCalls.length) {
      messages.push({
        role: 'assistant',
        content: msg.content || null,
        tool_calls: toolCalls,
      });
      for (const tc of toolCalls) {
        const name = tc.function?.name;
        opts.onToolEvent?.({ phase: 'start', name, id: tc.id });
        if (name === 'delegate_task' && delegateEmpty >= 2) {
          const blocked = { ok: false, error: 'delegate_task пропущен: два пустых запуска подряд' };
          opts.onToolEvent?.({ phase: 'end', name, id: tc.id, ok: false });
          messages.push({
            role: 'tool',
            tool_call_id: tc.id,
            content: JSON.stringify({ error: blocked.error }),
          });
          continue;
        }
        const out = await executeToolCall(tc);
        if (out.ok && out.result?.chart) charts.push(out.result.chart);
        if (name === 'delegate_task' && out.ok && !(out.result?.rows || []).length) {
          delegateEmpty += 1;
        }
        opts.onToolEvent?.({ phase: 'end', name, id: tc.id, ok: out.ok, error: out.error, chart: out.result?.chart });
        messages.push({
          role: 'tool',
          tool_call_id: tc.id,
          content: JSON.stringify(out.ok ? out.result : { error: out.error }, null, 0),
        });
        if (!out.ok) {
          const streak = (failStreak.get(name) || 0) + 1;
          failStreak.set(name, streak);
          if (streak >= 3) {
            const content = `Остановлено: инструмент ${name} трижды завершился ошибкой.\n\n${out.error || ''}`;
            opts.onAssistantDelta?.(content);
            return { content, messages, charts };
          }
        } else {
          failStreak.set(name, 0);
        }
      }
      continue;
    }

    const content = msg.content || '';
    opts.onAssistantDelta?.(content);
    return { content, messages: [...messages, { role: 'assistant', content }], charts };
  }

  throw new Error('Превышен лимит шагов инструментов');
}

async function loadSystemPromptViaBridge(agentId = 'default') {
  const out = await invoke1cTool('fs_read', { path: `agents/${agentId}.md` });
  if (out.ok && out.result?.content) return out.result.content;
  return 'Ты помощник 1СХарнесс. Используй инструменты для файлов и расчётов. Запросы к базе — только через run_query в сеансе 1С.';
}

/** Эмуляция платформы 1С в браузере: инструменты ТЗ через тот же контракт, что tools/python/stub_1c. */


const VFS_PREFIX = 'harness:vfs:';
const WORKSPACE_URL_PREFIX = '/workspace/';
const STUB_DEV_PROXY_BASE_RE = /\/dev-llm\/|127\.0\.0\.1:\d+\/dev-llm/i;

let manifestCache = null;

function vfsKeys() {
  const paths = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i += 1) {
    const key = localStorage.key(i);
    if (key && key.startsWith(VFS_PREFIX)) paths.push(key.slice(VFS_PREFIX.length));
  }
  return paths;
}

function vfsGet(path) {
  return localStorage.getItem(VFS_PREFIX + path);
}

function vfsSet(path, content) {
  localStorage.setItem(VFS_PREFIX + path, content ?? '');
}

function vfsRemove(path) {
  localStorage.removeItem(VFS_PREFIX + path);
}

function configJsonUsesDevProxy(content) {
  try {
    const o = JSON.parse(content);
    return STUB_DEV_PROXY_BASE_RE.test(o?.connection?.apiBase || '');
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function embeddedDisk() {
  return (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.__HARNESS_DISK) || null;
}

async function loadManifest() {
  if (manifestCache) return manifestCache;
  const disk = embeddedDisk();
  if (disk && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(disk, "manifest.json")) {
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(disk["manifest.json"]);
      manifestCache = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
    } catch {
      manifestCache = [];
    }
    return manifestCache;
  }
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${WORKSPACE_URL_PREFIX}manifest.json`);
    if (!res.ok) {
      manifestCache = [];
      return manifestCache;
    }
    const data = await res.json();
    manifestCache = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
  } catch {
    manifestCache = [];
  }
  return manifestCache;
}

async function readDisk(path) {
  const disk = embeddedDisk();
  if (disk && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(disk, path)) return disk[path];
  const res = await fetch(WORKSPACE_URL_PREFIX + path);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Файл не найден: ${path}`);
  return res.text();
}

const fs = {
  async read(path) {
    const overlay = vfsGet(path);
    if (path === 'config.json' && overlay !== null && configJsonUsesDevProxy(overlay)) {
      vfsRemove(path);
    } else if (overlay !== null) {
      return overlay;
    }
    return readDisk(path);
  },
  async write(path, content) {
    vfsSet(path, content ?? '');
  },
  async list() {
    const disk = await loadManifest();
    return [...new Set([...disk, ...vfsKeys()])].filter((p) => p && !p.endsWith('/.keep') ? true : true);
  },
  async searchChats(query) {
    const q = query.toLowerCase();
    const hits = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i += 1) {
      const key = localStorage.key(i);
      if (!key || !key.startsWith('llamaChatSession_')) continue;
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(key) || '';
      if (!raw.toLowerCase().includes(q)) continue;
      const at = raw.toLowerCase().indexOf(q);
      hits.push({
        session_id: key.slice('llamaChatSession_'.length),
        excerpt: raw.slice(Math.max(0, at - 40), at + query.length + 80).replace(/\s+/g, ' '),
      });
    }
    return hits;
  },
  async readSkills() {
    const paths = (await this.list()).filter((p) => p.startsWith('skills/') || p.startsWith('agents/'));
    const docs = [];
    for (const path of paths) {
      if (!path.endsWith('.md')) continue;
      try {
        docs.push({ path, content: await this.read(path) });
      } catch {
        /* skip missing */
      }
    }
    return docs;
  },
};

async function stub1cExecuteTool(name, args) {
  try {
    const result = await executeHarnessTool(name, args, fs);
    return { ok: true, result };
  } catch (e) {
    const payload = toolErrorPayload(e);
    return { ok: false, error: payload.message, hints: payload.hints };
  }
}

function installStub1CPlatformOnBridge(isReal1C) {
  document.addEventListener('harness-1c-request', async (ev) => {
    if (isReal1C()) return;
    const payload = ev.detail;
    if (!payload || payload.type !== 'tool.invoke') return;
    const out = await stub1cExecuteTool(payload.tool, payload.arguments);
    const response = {
      type: 'tool.result',
      id: payload.id,
      ok: out.ok,
      result: out.result,
      error: out.error,
      hints: out.hints,
    };
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('harness-1c-response', { detail: response }));
    });
  });
}

}

  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

        function openSessionSilently(sessionId) {

                chatHistory = JSON.parse(historyJson) || [];
                messageCounter = chatHistory.length;

        function configureMarked() {
            marked.setOptions({
                highlight: function(code, lang) {
                    const language = hljs.getLanguage(lang) ? lang : 'plaintext';
                    return hljs.highlight(code, { language, ignoreIllegals: true }).value;
                },
                gfm: true,
                breaks: true,
                langPrefix: 'hljs language-',
            });
        }
        function harnessChartPalette() {
            const taxi = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-palette') === 'taxi';
            const dark = (document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-bs-theme') || 'light') === 'dark';
            if (taxi) {
                return {
                    colors: ['#ffe289', '#5c7a8a', '#e6c85a', '#8aa4c0', '#fff5c0'],
                    grid: dark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)',
                    text: dark ? '#e8f0fb' : '#404040'
                };
            }
            return {
                colors: ['#007bff', '#0d8f4a', '#00e5ff', '#5a6f85', '#004080'],
                grid: dark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)' : 'rgba(0,51,102,0.08)',
                text: dark ? '#8aa4c0' : '#5a6f85'
            };
        }
        function destroyHarnessCharts(container) {
            if (typeof Chart === 'undefined' || !container) return;
            container.querySelectorAll('canvas.h-chart').forEach((canvas) => {
                const existing = Chart.getChart(canvas);
                if (existing) existing.destroy();
            });
        }
        function buildHarnessChartConfig(spec) {
            const pal = harnessChartPalette();
            const datasets = (spec.datasets || []).map((ds, i) => ({
                ...ds,
                backgroundColor: ds.backgroundColor || (spec.type === 'line'
                    ? pal.colors[i % pal.colors.length] + '33'
                    : pal.colors.map((c, j) => pal.colors[(i + j) % pal.colors.length])),
                borderColor: ds.borderColor || pal.colors[i % pal.colors.length],
                borderWidth: ds.borderWidth ?? (spec.type === 'line' ? 2 : 1),
                tension: ds.tension ?? 0.25,
                fill: ds.fill ?? (spec.type === 'line' ? false : true)
            }));
            return {
                type: spec.type === 'hbar' ? 'bar' : (spec.type || 'bar'),
                data: { labels: spec.labels || [], datasets },
                options: {
                    indexAxis: spec.type === 'hbar' ? 'y' : 'x',
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: true,
                    plugins: {
                        legend: {
                            display: datasets.length > 1 || ['pie', 'doughnut'].includes(spec.type),
                            labels: { color: pal.text, boxWidth: 12, font: { size: 11 } }
                        }
                    },
                    scales: ['pie', 'doughnut', 'radar'].includes(spec.type) ? {} : {
                        x: { ticks: { color: pal.text, maxRotation: 0, autoSkip: true }, grid: { color: pal.grid } },
                        y: { ticks: { color: pal.text }, grid: { color: pal.grid } }
                    }
                }
            };
        }
        function initHarnessCharts(container) {
            if (typeof Chart === 'undefined' || !container) return;
            container.querySelectorAll('canvas.h-chart[data-harness-chart]').forEach((canvas) => {
                if (Chart.getChart(canvas)) return;
                let spec;
                try {
                    spec = JSON.parse(canvas.getAttribute('data-harness-chart'));
                } catch (e) {
                    return;
                }
                new Chart(canvas.getContext('2d'), buildHarnessChartConfig(spec));
            });
        }
        function refreshChartsInChat() {
            if (!elements.chatContainer) return;
            elements.chatContainer.querySelectorAll('.kb-msg-body').forEach((body) => {
                destroyHarnessCharts(body);
                initHarnessCharts(body);
            });
        }

            setupHeaderMenu();

            if (elements.contextWindow) {
                elements.contextWindow.addEventListener('change', () => {

            if (elements.openAiBaseUrl) elements.openAiBaseUrl.addEventListener('change', saveAgentConnectionSettings);

                updateSendButtonState();
                autoResizeTextarea(elements.chatInput);
                updateContextMeter();
            });
            elements.chatInput.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
                if (event.key !== 'Enter' || event.isComposing) return;
                if (event.shiftKey) return;
                event.preventDefault();
                if (!elements.sendButton.disabled && !currentAbortController) {
                    handleSendPrompt();
                }
            });
            elements.fileInput.addEventListener('change', handleFileSelection);
            elements.stagedFilesArea.addEventListener('click', handleRemoveStagedFile);
            elements.chatContainer.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
                if (event.target.classList.contains('copy-code-button')) handleCopyCodeClick(event.target);
                else if (event.target.classList.contains('download-code-button')) handleDownloadCodeClick(event.target);
            });
            elements.settingsModal.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal', () => {
                if (elements.paletteSelect) elements.paletteSelect.value = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-palette') || 'krabobot';
                if (elements.brightnessSelect) elements.brightnessSelect.value = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-bs-theme') || 'light';
            });
            elements.sessionsList.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
                const actionBtn = event.target.closest('[data-session-action]');
                if (actionBtn) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    const row = actionBtn.closest('[data-session-id]');
                    if (!row) return;
                    const sessionId = row.dataset.sessionId;
                    const action = actionBtn.dataset.sessionAction;
                    if (action === 'rename') handleRenameSession(sessionId);
                    else if (action === 'delete') handleDeleteSession(sessionId);
                    return;
                }
                const menuBtn = event.target.closest('.kb-sess-menu-btn');
                if (menuBtn) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    const row = menuBtn.closest('[data-session-id]');
                    if (!row) return;
                    const dropdown = row.querySelector('.kb-sess-dropdown');
                    if (!dropdown) return;
                    const sid = row.dataset.sessionId;
                    if (openSessionMenuId && openSessionMenuId !== sid) {
                        const prev = elements.sessionsList.querySelector(`[data-session-id="${openSessionMenuId}"] .kb-sess-dropdown`);
                        if (prev) prev.hidden = true;
                    }
                    dropdown.hidden = !dropdown.hidden;
                    menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', dropdown.hidden ? 'false' : 'true');
                    openSessionMenuId = dropdown.hidden ? null : sid;
                    return;
                }
                const openBtn = event.target.closest('.kb-sess-btn');
                if (openBtn) {
                    const row = openBtn.closest('[data-session-id]');
                    if (row) handleLoadSession(row.dataset.sessionId);
                }

            document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {

                    elements.sessionsList.querySelectorAll('.kb-sess-dropdown').forEach(el => { el.hidden = true; });
                    openSessionMenuId = null;
                }
            });

            if (!elements.headerMenuDropdown) return;

        function autoResizeTextarea(textarea) {
            textarea.style.height = 'auto';
            textarea.style.height = Math.min(textarea.scrollHeight, 200) + 'px';
        }
        function updateSendButtonState() {
            if (currentAbortController) {
                elements.sendButton.disabled = false;
                return;
            }
            const isLoading = (elements.headerStatus && elements.headerStatus.querySelector('.kb-status-spinner')) ||
                (elements.statusBar && elements.statusBar.querySelector('.spinner-border') !== null);
            const canSend = !isLoading && (elements.chatInput.value.trim().length > 0 || stagedFiles.length > 0);
            elements.sendButton.disabled = !canSend;
        }
        function handleFileSelection(event) {
            const files = event.target.files;
            if (!files) return;
            showLoading(true, "Обработка файлов…");
            const newFiles = Array.from(files).filter(f => !stagedFiles.some(sf => sf.name === f.name));
            if (newFiles.length !== files.length) showStatus("Файлы с одинаковыми именами пропущены.", "warning");
            if (newFiles.length === 0) {
                showLoading(false);
                return;
            }
            let filesProcessed = 0;
            newFiles.forEach(file => {
                const reader = new FileReader();
                const fileData = { file, name: file.name, type: file.type, content: null, error: null };
                stagedFiles.push(fileData);
                reader.onload = e => {
                    fileData.content = e.target.result;
                    filesProcessed++;
                    if (filesProcessed === newFiles.length) finishFileProcessing();
                };
                reader.onerror = e => {
                    fileData.error = `Error reading file: ${e.target.error?.message || 'Unknown'}`;
                    filesProcessed++;
                    if (filesProcessed === newFiles.length) finishFileProcessing();
                };
                if (file.type.startsWith('text/') || /\.(txt|md|py|js|html|css|json|xml|csv|log)$/i.test(file.name)) {
                    reader.readAsText(file);
                } else {
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                }
            });
            renderStagedFiles();
            event.target.value = null;
        }
        function finishFileProcessing() {
            renderStagedFiles();
            showLoading(false);
            updateSendButtonState();
            elements.chatInput.focus();
        }
        function renderStagedFiles() {
            elements.stagedFilesArea.innerHTML = '';
            stagedFiles.forEach((fileData, index) => {
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.className = `badge d-flex align-items-center ${fileData.error ? 'text-bg-danger' : 'text-bg-secondary'}`;
                item.title = fileData.name + (fileData.error ? ` (ошибка: ${fileData.error})` : '');
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="me-2">${escapeHtml(fileData.name)}</span>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white" aria-label="Убрать файл" data-index="${index}"></button>
                `;
                elements.stagedFilesArea.appendChild(item);
            });
            updateSendButtonState();
            updateContextMeter();
        }
        function setSendButtonMode(mode) {
            if (mode === 'stop') {
                elements.sendButton.classList.add('is-stop');
                elements.sendButton.innerHTML = '<span class="compose-stop" aria-hidden="true"></span>';
                elements.sendButton.title = 'Остановить';
                elements.sendButton.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Остановить');
            } else {
                elements.sendButton.classList.remove('is-stop');
                elements.sendButton.innerHTML = SEND_BUTTON_SVG;
                elements.sendButton.title = 'Отправить';
                elements.sendButton.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Отправить');
            }
        }
        function updateComposeContext() {
            if (!elements.composeContext) return;
            if (!currentSessionId) {
                elements.composeContext.textContent = chatHistory.length ? 'Черновик' : '1СХарнесс';
                updateContextMeter();

            }
            const session = getSessionIndex().find(s => s.id === currentSessionId);
            elements.composeContext.textContent = session ? session.name : '1СХарнесс';
            updateContextMeter();
        }
        function handleRemoveStagedFile(event) {
            if (event.target.matches('[data-index]')) {
                const indexToRemove = parseInt(event.target.dataset.index, 10);
                stagedFiles.splice(indexToRemove, 1);
                renderStagedFiles();
            }
        }
        function clearStagedFiles() {
            stagedFiles = [];
            renderStagedFiles();
            elements.fileInput.value = null;
        }
        async function handleSendPrompt1C(promptText, fullUserContent) {
            setSendButtonMode('stop');
            elements.chatInput.disabled = true;
            if (currentAbortController) currentAbortController.abort();
            currentAbortController = new AbortController();
            const userMessage = { role: 'user', content: fullUserContent, id: `msg-${messageCounter++}` };
            chatHistory.push(userMessage);
            persistCurrentSession();
            renderChatHistory();
            elements.chatInput.value = '';
            autoResizeTextarea(elements.chatInput);
            clearStagedFiles();
            showLoading(true, '1С…');
            const modelMessage = { role: 'model', content: '', id: `msg-${messageCounter++}` };
            chatHistory.push(modelMessage);
            renderChatHistory();
            const envelope = {
                type: 'chat.completion',
                messages: chatHistory.slice(0, -1).map(m => ({
                    role: m.role === 'model' ? 'assistant' : m.role,
                    content: m.content
                }))
            };
            harnessPostToHost(envelope);
            try {
                const hostData = await waitHarnessHostResponse(12000);
                if (currentAbortController?.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
                if (hostData && (hostData.content || hostData.text)) {
                    modelMessage.content = hostData.content || hostData.text;
                } else if (hostData && hostData.error) {
                    modelMessage.content = `**Ошибка 1С:** ${hostData.error}`;
                } else {
                    modelMessage.content = harnessDefaultReply(promptText);
                }
                showStatus('Ответ от 1С.', 'success');
                persistCurrentSession();
            } catch (error) {
                if (error.name === 'AbortError') {
                    showStatus('Запрос остановлен.', 'info');
                    if (chatHistory[chatHistory.length - 1].content.length < 15) chatHistory.pop();
                    chatHistory.pop();
                } else {
                    showStatus(`Ошибка: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
                    chatHistory.pop();
                    chatHistory.pop();
                    elements.chatInput.value = promptText;
                    autoResizeTextarea(elements.chatInput);
                }
                renderChatHistory();
            } finally {
                updateModelBubbleContent(modelMessage.id, modelMessage.content, false);
                resetButtonToSendState();
                showLoading(false);
                elements.chatInput.disabled = false;
                currentAbortController = null;
                updateSendButtonState();
                elements.chatInput.focus();
            }
        }
        function chatHistoryToOpenAiTurn(excludeLastAssistant) {
            const list = excludeLastAssistant ? chatHistory.slice(0, -1) : chatHistory;
            return list.map(m => ({
                role: m.role === 'model' ? 'assistant' : m.role === 'user' ? 'user' : m.role,
                content: m.content || ''
            })).filter(m => m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'assistant');
        }
        async function handleSendPromptAgent(promptText, fullUserContent) {
            setSendButtonMode('stop');
            elements.chatInput.disabled = true;
            if (currentAbortController) currentAbortController.abort();
            currentAbortController = new AbortController();
            const userMessage = { role: 'user', content: fullUserContent, id: `msg-${messageCounter++}` };
            chatHistory.push(userMessage);
            persistCurrentSession();
            renderChatHistory();
            elements.chatInput.value = '';
            autoResizeTextarea(elements.chatInput);
            clearStagedFiles();
            showLoading(true, 'Агент…');
            const modelMessage = { role: 'model', content: '', id: `msg-${messageCounter++}` };
            chatHistory.push(modelMessage);
            renderChatHistory();
            const toolNotes = [];
            try {
                const temperature = parseFloat(elements.temperature.value);
                const result = await window.HarnessAgent.runHarnessAgentTurn({
                    turnMessages: chatHistoryToOpenAiTurn(true),
                    signal: currentAbortController.signal,
                    temperature: Number.isFinite(temperature) ? temperature : 0.4,
                    onToolEvent(ev) {
                        if (ev.phase === 'start') showLoading(true, `1С: ${ev.name}…`);
                        if (ev.phase === 'end' && ev.ok === false && ev.error) {
                            toolNotes.push(`**${ev.name}:** ${ev.error}`);
                        }
                    },
                });
                if (currentAbortController?.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
                let content = result.content || '_(пустой ответ)_';
                if (toolNotes.length && /^(error|ошибка)\.?$/i.test(content.trim())) {
                    content = toolNotes.join('\n\n');
                }
                for (const spec of result.charts || []) {
                    const payload = JSON.stringify(spec).replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
                    const title = spec.title ? `<figcaption>${escapeHtml(spec.title)}</figcaption>` : '';
                    content += `\n\n<figure class="h-chart-wrap">${title}<canvas class="h-chart" data-harness-chart='${payload}'></canvas></figure>`;
                }
                modelMessage.content = content;
                showStatus('Ответ получен.', 'success');
                persistCurrentSession();
            } catch (error) {
                if (error.name === 'AbortError') {
                    showStatus('Запрос остановлен.', 'info');
                    if (chatHistory[chatHistory.length - 1].content.length < 15) chatHistory.pop();
                    chatHistory.pop();
                } else {
                    showStatus(`Ошибка: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
                    chatHistory.pop();
                    chatHistory.pop();
                    elements.chatInput.value = promptText;
                    autoResizeTextarea(elements.chatInput);
                }
                renderChatHistory();
            } finally {
                updateModelBubbleContent(modelMessage.id, modelMessage.content, false);
                resetButtonToSendState();
                showLoading(false);
                elements.chatInput.disabled = false;
                currentAbortController = null;
                updateSendButtonState();
                elements.chatInput.focus();
            }
        }
        async function handleSendPrompt() {
            setSendButtonMode('stop');
            elements.chatInput.disabled = true;
            let promptText = elements.chatInput.value.trim();
            if (!promptText && stagedFiles.length === 0) {
                showStatus("Сообщение не может быть пустым.", "warning");
                resetButtonToSendState();
                elements.chatInput.disabled = false;
                return;
            }
            const filesWithError = stagedFiles.filter(f => f.error);
            if (filesWithError.length > 0) {
                showStatus(`Ошибка чтения файлов: ${filesWithError.map(f => f.name).join(', ')}`, "danger");
                resetButtonToSendState();
                elements.chatInput.disabled = false;
                return;
            }
            let fileInfoForPrompt = "";
            if (stagedFiles.length > 0) {
                fileInfoForPrompt = "Attached Files:\n";
                stagedFiles.forEach(fileData => {
                    fileInfoForPrompt += `[File: ${fileData.name} (${fileData.type})]\n`;
                    if (fileData.type.startsWith('text/') && fileData.content && fileData.content.length < MAX_TEXT_FILE_EMBED_SIZE) {
                        fileInfoForPrompt += `Content:\n---\n${fileData.content}\n---\n`;
                    } else if (!fileData.type.startsWith('text/') && fileData.content?.startsWith('data:')) {
                        fileInfoForPrompt += `(File is binary/image - content not embedded in text prompt)\n`;
                    } else if (fileData.type.startsWith('text/')) {
                        fileInfoForPrompt += `(Text file content too large to embed in prompt)\n`;
                    }
                });
                fileInfoForPrompt += "\nUser Message:\n";
            }
            const fullUserContent = fileInfoForPrompt + promptText;
            if (window.HarnessAgent?.runHarnessAgentTurn) {
                await handleSendPromptAgent(promptText, fullUserContent);
                return;
            }
            if (harnessBackendEnabled()) {
                await handleSendPrompt1C(promptText, fullUserContent);
                return;
            }
            showStatus('Агент не загружен.', 'danger');
            resetButtonToSendState();
            elements.chatInput.disabled = false;
        }
        function handleStopGeneration() {
            if (currentAbortController) currentAbortController.abort();
        }
        function resetButtonToSendState() {
            setSendButtonMode('send');
        }
        function paintHeaderStatus(message, type, isLoading) {
            if (!elements.headerStatus) return;
            elements.headerStatus.className = 'kb-status' + (type ? ` is-${type}` : '');
            if (isLoading) {
                elements.headerStatus.classList.add('kb-status--busy');
                elements.headerStatus.innerHTML = `<span class="kb-status-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>${escapeHtml(message)}</span>`;
            } else if (message) {
                elements.headerStatus.classList.remove('kb-status--busy');
                elements.headerStatus.textContent = message;
            } else {
                elements.headerStatus.classList.remove('kb-status--busy');
                elements.headerStatus.textContent = '';
            }
        }
        function showLoading(isLoading, message = "") {
            if (isLoading) {
                paintHeaderStatus(message || 'Обработка…', 'info', true);
            } else if (!elements.headerStatus?.classList.contains('is-danger') && !elements.headerStatus?.classList.contains('is-warning')) {
                paintHeaderStatus('', '', false);
            }
        }
        function showStatus(message, type = "info") {
            showLoading(false);
            paintHeaderStatus(message, type, false);
            if (type !== 'danger' && type !== 'warning') {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (elements.headerStatus && elements.headerStatus.textContent === message) {
                        paintHeaderStatus('', '', false);
                    }
                }, 4000);
            }
        }
        function createMessageElement(message) {
            const messageWrapper = document.createElement('div');
            const roleClass = message.role === 'user' ? 'kb-msg--user' : 'kb-msg--assistant';
            messageWrapper.className = `kb-msg ${roleClass}`;
            messageWrapper.dataset.messageId = message.id;
            messageWrapper.dataset.role = message.role;
            const label = message.role === 'user' ? 'Вы' : '1СХарнесс';
            const bodyClass = message.role === 'model' ? 'kb-msg-body kb-msg-body--md' : 'kb-msg-body';
            messageWrapper.innerHTML = `<div class="kb-msg-label">${label}</div><div class="${bodyClass}"></div>`;
            const bodyElement = messageWrapper.querySelector('.kb-msg-body');
            if (message.role === 'model' && message.content) {
                bodyElement.innerHTML = marked.parse(message.content);
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    addCodeActionsToBubble(bodyElement);
                    initHarnessCharts(bodyElement);
                });
            } else if (message.role === 'user') {
                bodyElement.textContent = message.content;
            }
            return messageWrapper;
        }
        function renderChatHistory() {
            if (chatHistory.length === 0) {
                elements.chatContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="kb-empty-state"><h2>1СХарнесс</h2><p class="kb-empty-lead">ИИ-агент на платформе 1С:Предприятие</p><p>Запросы, отчёты и инструменты выполняются через 1С. Напишите сообщение или нажмите «Новый диалог».</p></div>`;
            } else {
                destroyHarnessCharts(elements.chatContainer);
                elements.chatContainer.innerHTML = '';
                chatHistory.forEach(message => elements.chatContainer.appendChild(createMessageElement(message)));
                scrollToBottom();
            }
            updateComposeContext();
        }
        function updateModelBubbleContent(messageId, newContent, isStreamingUpdate = false) {
            const messageDiv = document.querySelector(`.kb-msg[data-message-id="${messageId}"][data-role="model"] .kb-msg-body`);
            if (!messageDiv) return;
            destroyHarnessCharts(messageDiv);
            messageDiv.innerHTML = marked.parse(newContent || (isStreamingUpdate ? "" : "_(пустой ответ)_"));
            addCodeActionsToBubble(messageDiv);
            initHarnessCharts(messageDiv);
            if (isStreamingUpdate) scrollToBottom();
        }
        function addCodeActionsToBubble(container) {
            container.querySelectorAll('pre').forEach(pre => {
                if (pre.querySelector('.code-actions')) return;
                pre.style.position = 'relative';
                const codeElement = pre.querySelector('code');
                if (!codeElement) return;
                const actionsContainer = document.createElement('div');
                actionsContainer.className = 'code-actions';
                actionsContainer.innerHTML = `
                    <button class="code-action-button copy-code-button" title="Копировать код">Копировать</button>
                    <button class="code-action-button download-code-button" title="Скачать код">Скачать</button>
                `;
                pre.prepend(actionsContainer);
            });
        }
        function handleCopyCodeClick(button) {
            const code = button.closest('pre')?.querySelector('code')?.textContent || '';
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
                button.textContent = 'Скопировано';
                button.classList.add('copied');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    button.textContent = 'Копировать';
                    button.classList.remove('copied');
                }, 2000);
            });
        }
        function handleDownloadCodeClick(button) {
            const pre = button.closest('pre');
            const code = pre?.querySelector('code');
            if (!code) return;
            const langClass = Array.from(code.classList).find(c => c.startsWith('language-'));
            const lang = langClass ? langClass.replace('language-', '') : 'txt';
            const blob = new Blob([code.textContent], { type: 'text/plain' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = `code-${lang}.${lang}`;
            a.click();
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        }
        function escapeHtml(unsafe) {
            return unsafe.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
        }
        function scrollToBottom() {
            elements.chatContainer.scrollTop = elements.chatContainer.scrollHeight;
        }
        function getSessionIndex() {
            try {
                const index = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SESSION_INDEX_KEY));
                return Array.isArray(index) ? index : [];
            } catch { return []; }
        }
        function saveSessionIndex(index) {
            localStorage.setItem(SESSION_INDEX_KEY, JSON.stringify(index));
        }
        function deriveSessionTitle() {
            const userMsg = chatHistory.find(m => m.role === 'user');
            if (!userMsg) return `${DEFAULT_SESSION_NAME} ${new Date().toLocaleString('ru-RU')}`;
            let text = String(userMsg.content || '');
            text = text.replace(/^Attached Files:[\s\S]*?User Message:\n/m, '').trim();
            text = text.split('\n')[0].trim();
            if (text.length > 42) text = `${text.slice(0, 41)}…`;
            return text || `${DEFAULT_SESSION_NAME} ${new Date().toLocaleString('ru-RU')}`;
        }
        function persistCurrentSession() {
            if (!chatHistory.length) return;
            let sessions = getSessionIndex();
            if (!currentSessionId) {
                currentSessionId = `${Date.now()}`;
                sessions.unshift({ id: currentSessionId, name: deriveSessionTitle(), updatedAt: Date.now() });
            } else {
                const session = sessions.find(s => s.id === currentSessionId);
                if (session) {
                    session.updatedAt = Date.now();
                    if (session.name === DEFAULT_SESSION_NAME || session.name.startsWith(`${DEFAULT_SESSION_NAME} `)) {
                        session.name = deriveSessionTitle();
                    }
                }
            }
            localStorage.setItem(`${SESSION_DATA_PREFIX}${currentSessionId}`, JSON.stringify(chatHistory));
            sessions.sort((a, b) => (b.updatedAt || 0) - (a.updatedAt || 0));
            saveSessionIndex(sessions);
            populateSessions();
            updateComposeContext();
            if (harnessAgentMode() && window.HarnessAgent?.persistSessionJsonViaBridge) {
                const session = sessions.find(s => s.id === currentSessionId);
                window.HarnessAgent.persistSessionJsonViaBridge(currentSessionId, {
                    id: currentSessionId,
                    name: session?.name || DEFAULT_SESSION_NAME,
                    updatedAt: session?.updatedAt || Date.now(),
                    messages: chatHistory
                }).catch(() => {});
            }
        }
        function populateSessions() {
            const sessions = getSessionIndex().slice().sort((a, b) => (b.updatedAt || 0) - (a.updatedAt || 0));
            elements.sessionsList.innerHTML = '';
            openSessionMenuId = null;
            if (!sessions.length) {
                const empty = document.createElement('li');
                empty.className = 'kb-sessions-empty';
                empty.textContent = 'Пока нет сохранённых диалогов';
                elements.sessionsList.appendChild(empty);
                return;
            }
            sessions.forEach(session => {
                const item = document.createElement('li');
                item.className = `kb-sess ${session.id === currentSessionId ? 'kb-sess--active' : ''}`;
                item.dataset.sessionId = session.id;
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <button type="button" class="kb-sess-btn" title="${escapeHtml(session.name)}">${escapeHtml(session.name)}</button>
                    <div class="kb-sess-menu-wrap">
                        <button type="button" class="kb-sess-menu-btn" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Действия с диалогом">⋯</button>
                        <div class="kb-sess-dropdown" hidden>
                            <button type="button" class="kb-dropdown-item" data-session-action="rename">Переименовать</button>
                            <button type="button" class="kb-dropdown-item text-danger" data-session-action="delete">Удалить</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                elements.sessionsList.appendChild(item);
            });
        }
        function startNewSession() {
            if (currentAbortController) currentAbortController.abort();
            chatHistory = [];
            currentSessionId = null;
            messageCounter = 0;
            clearStagedFiles();
            renderChatHistory();
            showStatus("");
            updateSendButtonState();
            populateSessions();
            updateComposeContext();
            elements.chatInput.focus();
        }
        function handleLoadSession(sessionId) {
            if (sessionId === currentSessionId) return;
            const hasDraft = chatHistory.length > 0 && !currentSessionId;
            if (hasDraft && !confirm('Текущий черновик не сохранён. Открыть другой чат?')) return;
            try {
                const historyJson = localStorage.getItem(`${SESSION_DATA_PREFIX}${sessionId}`);
                chatHistory = JSON.parse(historyJson) || [];
                messageCounter = chatHistory.length;
                currentSessionId = sessionId;
                renderChatHistory();
                populateSessions();
                updateContextMeter();
                showStatus("Чат открыт.", "info");
            } catch (e) {
                showStatus("Не удалось открыть чат.", "danger");
            }
        }
        function handleRenameSession(sessionId) {
            const sessions = getSessionIndex();
            const session = sessions.find(s => s.id === sessionId);
            if (!session) return;
            const newName = prompt('Название чата:', session.name);
            if (!newName?.trim()) return;
            session.name = newName.trim();
            session.updatedAt = Date.now();
            saveSessionIndex(sessions);
            populateSessions();
            showStatus('Чат переименован.', 'success');
        }
        function handleDeleteSession(sessionId) {
            const sessions = getSessionIndex();
            const session = sessions.find(s => s.id === sessionId);
            if (!session || !confirm(`Удалить «${session.name}»? Это нельзя отменить.`)) return;
            localStorage.removeItem(`${SESSION_DATA_PREFIX}${sessionId}`);
            saveSessionIndex(sessions.filter(s => s.id !== sessionId));
            if (currentSessionId === sessionId) startNewSession();
            else populateSessions();
            showStatus(`«${session.name}» удалён.`, 'info');
        }
        if (window.HarnessAgent) {
            initialize();
        } else {
            document.addEventListener('harness-agent-ready', () => { initialize(); }, { once: true });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
